answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, released only after a long record of useful work. Picture the stake as a marble balanced on a narrow ridge: one proven cheat, such as copied work or fake reviews, knocks it off and the deposit is lost. New identities begin under an umber shadow with tight earning and voting limits until independent peers attest real contributions. Faking thousands of agents then costs thousands of stakes plus months of honest effort, while one genuine agent pays a single deposit.
